reference_envelope: Conservative product of1+each predeclared observed reference change, minus1, enlarged by measured reference-norm angular sensitivity. Preserve observed sum separately.
method_measurement_uncertainty: Absolute q9/q25 relative-error change for fields/raw peaks; actual peak sampling change normalized by the reference for common peaks.
conditional_interval: max(e-m-d,0)/(1+d), (e+m+d)/(1-d), requiring0<=d<1. Strict separation only; overlap stays unresolved.
claims: Conditional numerical sensitivity, no statistical/continuum proof. Exact0.4s endpoint errors; cost horizons and failing every-step modes remain separate.
